screens.title: Understand the page
screens.purpose: Step 1 of 4: Understand the page. Two press photos appear as responsive figures inside the festival gallery: Tribeca first, then Coachella; the figures sit side by side on wide screens and stack below roughly 900px. Review the existing alt text alongside the Tribeca and Coachella photos, their page context, credits, and cached AltText.ai and AltContext captions. Each figure keeps its marginal caption metadata collapsed behind native <details><summary> disclosures, and the name chooser is rendered next to each photo. Example page: Tribeca Festival 2026: red carpet photos. Current alt text in the demo copy: A man in a black suit and a woman in a white dress pose together, smiling, in front of a Tribeca Festival step-and-repeat backdrop. Names can be useful in this gallery when the editor has enough evidence to include them. Leaving someone unnamed is also a valid choice. Each photo has a saved example and image-credits disclosure. Review name suggestions is always enabled.

slices: **Entry + four steps** — compact intro, numbered guide, context → names → draft → apply
**Name radios** — no preselection; both undecided, one undecided, four include/omit combinations

**Apply / undo / outcome** — enabled vs disabled Apply, empty vs nonempty undo stack, applied vs kept
**Live last** — closed by default; unavailable-unverified / pending / complete / failed / timed_out / stopped / no_result do not block core
